title: The Movers and Shakers of Naya

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara overrun with lush tropical jungle, the cradle of life with the most varied forms of life, home to humans, elves, Nacatl and gargantuans.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane broken by the Sundering into five shards.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara where humans are extinction-threatened.

entities.name: Whitecover
entities.description: A permanent pale mist hanging over Naya's rainforest.

entities.name: Cylian elves
entities.description: The elves of Naya, the plane's spiritual center, who gather around dewcups and are led by the Anima.

entities.name: Cylia
entities.description: The first elvish high priest, who the Cylian elves believe witnessed the breaking of the world.

entities.name: Mayael
entities.description: The current Anima of the Cylian elves, who reads the signs of the forest as prophecy.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: The ancient hydra god who the elves believe slumbers below Naya.

entities.name: Sundering of Alara
entities.description: The breaking of Alara into its five shards.

entities.name: Nacatl
entities.description: Ferocious leonin jungle warriors of Naya, grouped into prides, split into the Wild Nacatl and Cloud Nacatl.

entities.name: The Coil
entities.description: The laws and strictures once governing the unified Nacatl empire, inscribed on a great wall of white stone.

entities.name: Breaking of the Coil
entities.description: The Nacatl civil war in which the white wall housing the Coil was broken and the race split in two.

entities.name: Marisi
entities.description: A revolutionary Nacatl who led the revolt against the Coil, believed long dead and celebrated with a yearly festival.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker native to Naya who belongs to a Wild Nacatl pride.

entities.name: Jazal Goldmane
entities.description: Ajani's brother, murdered during a Festival of Marisi.

entities.name: Gargantuans
entities.description: The huge beasts of Naya, worshiped as gods by the Cylian elves.

entities.name: Exuberants
entities.description: Pleasure-loving humans of Naya who celebrate life in sandstone ziggurats and jungle cities.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A spherical plane with a hollow core; its suns are part of the plane.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara with a grid-divided night sky and etherium.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The chaotic void between the planes.

events.summary: The Nacatl rebel under Marisi against the Coil in a civil war, breaking the white wall and splitting the race into Wild and Cloud Nacatl.
events.quote: A revolutionary Nacatl named Marisi called upon his fellow leonin to revolt against the strictures of the Coil, and a great civil war broke out.

events.summary: Jazal Goldmane is murdered during a Festival of Marisi.
events.quote: It was during a Festival of Marisi that Ajani Goldmane's brother, Jazal, was murdered.

relations.quote: It was during a Festival of Marisi that Ajani Goldmane's brother, Jazal, was murdered.

relations.note: part of a Wild Nacatl pride
relations.quote: The planeswalker Ajani Goldmane is native to Naya, and is part of a Wild Nacatl pride.
Mayael, the elves' current Anima, reads the signs of the forest as prophecy

relations.note: leader of the revolution of the Wild Nacatl
relations.quote: The leader of the revolution, Marisi, is believed to be long dead
The elves believe the gargantuans are sacred creatures, pure manifestations of the carnivorous ferocity of the jungle, and worship them as gods.
